title: Give option to save Error and Event List log file locally
symptom: Users want to save the Error and Event List log data to a local file, as currently the only option is to email it, which is not convenient for sharing or debugging.
fix: Starting with the August 2, 2024 release, you can save logs locally.
evidence_quote: Starting with the August 2, 2024 release, you can save logs locally.
